name: openim
description: Read-only search and retrieval over the Open Investment Model (OpenIM), the open, MIT-licensed reference model for institutional buy-side investment management.
long_description: An open, vendor-neutral reference model for institutional investment management: a service-domain decomposition of the buy-side firm and a canonical entity model. Search model elements from plain language, retrieve versioned content with official source links, map requirements to candidate elements, and list machine-readable exports. Read-only; no accounts, no telemetry, no investment advice.
